verdict.rationale: Cekura documents A/B testing to compare two agent versions side-by-side for prompt/model/config changes (cekura-docs-10), plus dashboards for visualizing metrics/call data (cekura-docs-11) and running the same scenarios across platforms/models to pick the best (cekura-docs-17), which directly supports catching regressions between versions. However, evidence is docs-only with no independent/hands-on confirmation of a dedicated 'eval run' comparison UI or regression-diff view beyond A/B testing framing. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the comparison workflow, and explicit documentation of a run-vs-run regression report distinct from A/B testing.
